name: 1923 Rosemary Focaccia & Date-Olive Loaf with Honey Butter (Night 1)
whyItWorks: The soft white dinner rolls and interior focaccia crumb with whipped honey butter are gentle and seedless.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose the plain white rolls or focaccia crumb with honey butter and skip the olive-studded loaf slices if flaring.
watchOuts: Olive skins and woody rosemary needles on specialty slices
